title: Take Until
statement: Implement `solve(items, limit)`. Return the prefix of integers that are strictly less than `limit`, stopping at the first value that is not. Later small values after a large one are not included. This is takewhile, not a filter.
hints: Walk until an item is >= limit.
An empty prefix is an empty list.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: filter would drop the large value and keep later small ones.

editorial: filter would drop the large value and keep later small ones. takewhile defines a prefix. The difference shows up as soon as a value breaks the predicate and a later value would have passed.
